description: This Java class defines configuration properties for creating and validating cryptographic signatures, including fields for secrets, key paths, token expiration, and certificate paths, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: SignatureSupportingConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for cryptographic signature support, including secret management, key and certificate path handling, and token expiration settings.

methods.name: getSharedSecret
methods.description: Returns the shared secret used for HMAC SHA256 signature creation and validation.

methods.name: setSharedSecret
methods.description: Sets the shared secret, ensuring it is at least 32 bytes long, and not null.

methods.name: setKeyPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the private key used for signing.

methods.name: getKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the private key file.

methods.name: getTokenExpiration
methods.description: Returns the token expiration period in seconds.

methods.name: setTokenExpiration
methods.description: Sets the token expiration period, must be greater than zero.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the X.509 certificate used for validation.

methods.name: getCertPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the certificate file.

methods.name: isAppropriateForCreating
methods.description: Checks if configuration has enough information for creating signatures.

methods.name: isAppropriateForValidating
methods.description: Checks if configuration has enough information for validating signatures.
